title: Quinoa salad with kale, avocado and cranberries
blurb: A fresh grain salad with nutty quinoa, tender kale, creamy avocado and sweet-tart cranberries.
steps: Rinse the quinoa under cold water, then place in a small pan with 250ml water and a pinch of salt. Bring to the boil, reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 12 minutes until the water is absorbed and the grains are tender.
Strip the kale leaves from their tough stems and tear into bite-sized pieces. Place in a large bowl and massage with your hands for a minute or two until the leaves soften and darken.
Peel and finely slice the shallot. Halve the avocado, remove the stone and scoop the flesh from the skin, then cut into chunks.
Fluff the cooked quinoa with a fork and leave to cool for a few minutes, then add to the bowl with the kale.
Add the shallot, avocado and cranberries to the bowl. Drizzle over the olive oil and lemon juice, season with salt and toss everything together gently until combined.
